input_scope.part_order: numeric file-part order; unnumbered part precedes no numbered peer

depth_0.missing_relation: leave feature values missing after base-left-join
depth_0.date_fields: official *D fields parse strictly to dates and become signed whole days source_date - date_decision

depth_1.row_count_feature: d1__{family}__row_count; zero when no related row

date_aggregations.conversion: strict parse official *D field then signed whole days source_date - base.date_decision
date_aggregations.future_information_rule: use only values present in the frozen application snapshot; never refresh after date_decision; a positive signed scheduled date is not itself treated as an observed future outcome

depth_1.categorical_mode_tie_break: Unicode NFC then casefold then original UTF-8 byte order
depth_1.empty_group_rule: row_count=0; every other aggregate is missing
depth_1.order_columns: num_group1 is sort-only and never a predictor or numeric measurement

collision_handling.rule: always prefix depth and table family before source name; append aggregation for depth 1

preprocessing.boolean_storage: nullable booleans become numeric 0/1 with missing preserved before fold-local imputation

selector_stage.numeric: replace infinities with missing; training median; all-missing fallback 0; float32
selector_stage.categorical: training-only Unicode string category map; <MISSING> token; unseen=-1; one numeric column per original candidate

final_model_stage.numeric: training mean imputation then StandardScaler; all-missing fallback 0; float32

preprocessing.constant_and_all_missing: retain as authenticated original candidates; deterministic training-fit preprocessing maps them to constants and records them; no outcome-informed pruning
preprocessing.high_cardinality: no feature-level cardinality exclusion; fold-local min_frequency=10 groups rare categorical levels; resource feasibility belongs to the bounded pilot
preprocessing.unsupported_dtype: fail closed and require a versioned pre-result amendment; none observed in the included schema

leakage_boundaries.fit_for_oot: fit once on full DEV then transform locked OOT unchanged
leakage_boundaries.domain_feature_engineering: forbidden beyond this deterministic relational reduction
